description: Turn your legal project requirements into an editable brief with a clear outcome, deliverables, budget, timing and open questions. Explore limited Lawtrades profile previews by practice area, skill, seniority and location, or preview the small-business attorney bench and its listed hourly rates. Continue at Lawtrades with the exact brief and up to three selected public profile references you approve, so you can build on your progress. The plugin is free and does not require a Lawtrades account. Creating a Lawtrades account is also free; paid project engagements are arranged separately on Lawtrades. A private continuation link expires after ten minutes; importing it transfers only the approved draft and profile references, not your full conversation. Access to a full profile may require sign-in and an existing relationship. This plugin does not provide legal advice, publish projects, contact attorneys, book consultations, request quotes, engage anyone or process payments. Professional availability and jurisdiction coverage vary. Location filters do not verify bar admission, listed rates are not project quotes, and your budget is a planning constraint.
